title: QA Workbench Export Packet
description: Schema for a governed QA workbench export packet. Packages one or more QA workbench items with structured evidence links, lifecycle history, query metadata, and advisory-only authority disclaimers. Export packets are governed review artifacts — they do not verify item correctness, imply defect acceptance, imply Owner approval, or close/seal/promote QA items.

packet_type.description: How this packet was produced: single item export, query result, bulk export, or snapshot.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the packet was generated.

command.description: The CLI command used to generate this packet.

source_query.description: Metadata about how this packet was generated. Read-only audit trail.

item_ids.description: List of QA item IDs included in this packet.

items.description: QA workbench item conforming to qa-workbench-item.schema.json.

included_items.description: The QA items included in this export packet.

evidence_links_aggregate.description: Aggregate count of evidence links across all included items.

lifecycle_summary.description: Summary of lifecycle transitions across all included items.

validator_summary.description: Summary of validator results for the included items (may be null if not yet validated).

authority_disclaimer.const: This export packet is advisory-only. It does not verify item correctness, imply defect acceptance, imply Owner approval, or close/seal/promote QA items. Custody is qa-pilot-local. Librarian impact is none.
authority_disclaimer.description: Standard authority disclaimer. Must match exactly.

custody.description: Must always be qa-pilot-local. Export packets cannot claim cross-project or Librarian custody.

advisory_only.description: Must always be true. Export packets are advisory-only review artifacts.

librarian_impact.description: Must always be none. Export packets do not mutate Librarian state.
